name: Skardvakt - The Black Tower
creator: Aodi
description:
"Skardvakt — The Black Watchtower
by Aodi

Cut from black marble and crowned with fire, Skardvakt rises like a forgotten sentinel over the land. Its circular tower, rimmed with sharpened spires, stands as both warning and monument—daring the night to come closer.

A bonfire burns at its peak, casting light across the treetops and shadows down the walls. Beneath the flame, the structure offers no comfort—only presence, silence, and the suggestion that someone—or something—once stood watch here.

Whether used as a signal tower, landmark, or quiet dare to the gods, Skardvakt endures.

Stand tall. Burn bright. Aodi passed through here."
